1.

It is a name we love here, Whose praise we will sing; The sweetest music it is, Our ear listens to.

2.

It speaks of a Friend so good, Who for us suffered and died; It speaks of His precious blood, Which is sufficient for all sin.

3.

It shows how our Father here Ever supplies us with help, And though our way may be so dark, That name gives sunshine.

4.

It names One who loves us, Who understands the least distress, Who bears all sorrows with us And dries every tear.

5.

It gives peace and security, It imparts comfort and courage, In "gentle breezes" it speaks Of how "God is good."

6.

And Jesus is the precious name, Which is so dear to us here; On earth no one can comprehend What this name is worth.

7.

Its fragrance that name shall spread On the path of our pilgrimage here; And if we walk through the valley of death, It grants sweet comfort.

8.

When at last in the Father’s house In glory we stand, Of Jesus’ name with many saints May we yet sing.
